answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 24 identities per epoch. Audits are written down in tide, queued in beacon, and violet publishes the wait time. A farm of 324 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 2466 identities would post 2007 proofs and burn roughly 74 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
